datasets.help: The row with the value column and the optional label column, each column described individually under keys. The value column is required for a chart. To clear, set one empty row ([{ value: null, label: null }]); [] is rejected.

value.label: V
value.title: Value column (numeric)
value.help: The value column (slot value); the slices are made from it. Required, empty until one is chosen.

label.label: G
label.title: Grouping (categorical)
label.help: The label column (slot label), optional. With it the values are summed per label; without it each distinct value becomes a slice, counted by frequency. Empty until one is chosen.

stats.help: The slice table, each figure described individually under keys; null while there is no slice (no value column, no values, or a column cannot be read).

activeColumnSlots.help: The slot keys a row of the datasets carries: value, label.

slices.help: The slices (name, value, colour) from the chosen columns, as the chart draws them; empty while there are no values.

PieStats.slices: The slices in table order (order of first appearance).
PieStats.total: The sum of all slice values, negative ones count as 0; the basis of the shares.

Slice.name: The category, that is the name of the slice: with a label column the label, without one the value itself.
Slice.value: The value of the slice: with a label column the sum of the values of that label (non-numeric or negative values are dropped), without one the frequency of the value.
Slice.share: The share of the slice in the sum of all slices, as a fraction from 0 to 1; the table shows it as a percentage.
